commands.name: passage
commands.summary: Read a passage.

options.description: include N verses of surrounding context

commands.name: read
commands.summary: Read the text sequentially, paged into context-sized chunks — study by reading, not just querying.

commands.name: outline
commands.summary: The shape of a whole book in one call: every chapter with its opening words, size, and most distinctive vocabulary.

commands.name: study
commands.summary: Inductive reading sessions: a durable cursor over a scope plus a verse-anchored notebook — read, observe, record; search follows observation. Start with: bible study start Genesis

commands.name: search
commands.summary: Full-text search.

options.description: treat the query as an exact phrase

commands.name: compare
commands.summary: Compare a verse across translations.

commands.name: interlinear
commands.summary: Word-by-word original language with English.

commands.name: original
commands.summary: Original-language text of a passage.

options.description: Greek edition: na27|na28|sbl|tr|byz|wh|treg|tyn (default: modern critical stream)
include non-default variant words with their edition flags

commands.name: syntax
commands.summary: Clause search over the MACULA treebanks: who did what to whom.

options.description: Strong's number or lemma that must appear in the clause's subject
Strong's number or lemma of the clause's verb (or copula)
Strong's number or lemma in the clause's (direct or second) object
Strong's number or lemma appearing in any role of the clause
only clauses the trees mark as negated (Hebrew לא/אל/אין, Greek οὐ/μή family)

commands.name: lemma
commands.summary: Occurrences of a lemma or Strong's number.

commands.name: word
commands.summary: Word study: lexicon entries + usage stats.

commands.name: morph
commands.summary: Full parse of every word in a verse.

commands.name: grep-morph
commands.summary: Search by grammatical form.

options.description: verb, noun, adjective, pronoun, article, preposition, conjunction, particle, suffix, adverb
Hebrew binyan: qal, niphal, piel, pual, hiphil, hophal, hithpael, …
Greek: aorist, present, perfect…; Hebrew: perfect, imperfect, wayyiqtol, participle, …
Greek: indicative, subjunctive, optative, imperative, infinitive, participle
Greek: nominative, genitive, dative, accusative, vocative
raw morphology code GLOB, e.g. 'V-2A*' or 'HVqw*'

commands.name: variants
commands.summary: Textual variants for a verse or short range, repackaged from the tagged data: per-edition Greek texts with edition-disputed words (NT), Masoretic Ketiv/Qere and LXX-stream readings (OT), and alternate Hebrew/Greek versification. Printed-edition-level evidence, not a manuscript apparatus.

commands.name: survey
commands.summary: Corpus dossier for a topic — run this FIRST in any study. Accepts a Strong's number, original-language lemma, English word, or passage.

commands.name: quotes
commands.summary: OT-in-NT parallels computed from the Greek (LXX vs NT), in confidence tiers: quotation (5+ word run), allusion (4-word run), echo (shared rare vocabulary).

options.description: minimum tier: 'quotation' | 'allusion' | 'echo' (default: allusion — echoes are speculative)
minimum shared word run for run tiers (default 4)
include the English text of the counterpart verses

commands.name: parallels
commands.summary: Inner-biblical parallels within a testament, computed from original-language lemma runs (Kings↔Chronicles, Psalm doublets, Synoptics, Jude↔2 Peter), in confidence tiers: parallel (5+ lemma run), allusion (4), echo (3 rare lemmas).

options.description: minimum tier: 'parallel' | 'allusion' | 'echo' (default: allusion — echoes are speculative)

commands.name: xref
commands.summary: Ranked cross-references.

options.description: also list verses that reference THIS verse

commands.name: freq
commands.summary: Frequency distribution.

options.description: Strong's number (true token counts from tagged text)
English word (counts verses containing it, per translation)

commands.name: cooccur
commands.summary: Co-occurrence analysis.

options.description: two or more Strong's numbers: find verses containing all of them

commands.name: similar
commands.summary: Passages sharing distinctive vocabulary with a passage (idf-weighted lemma overlap; lexical, not semantic).

options.description: bridge Hebrew↔Greek via lexicon links (e.g. LXX-informed equivalents)

commands.name: name
commands.summary: Who/what is this? Individualised persons and places.

commands.name: pattern
commands.summary: Original-language formula search: find verses where a sequence of Strong's numbers and/or original-script lemmas occurs in order, with observed-vs-expected concentration by book. Original-language only — English words are not accepted (find Strong's numbers with 'bible word').

options.description: space-separated Strong's numbers (H430, G26, H2617a) and/or original-script lemmas, in order
limit scope: 'ot', 'nt', a book, or a range ('Gen-Deu')
max intervening words allowed between consecutive items (default 0)

commands.name: books
commands.summary: List the 66 books with codes, chapter counts, and verse-id ranges

commands.name: translations
commands.summary: List available translations

commands.name: editions
commands.summary: List Greek NT editions available for --edition filters

commands.name: morph-codes
commands.summary: Explain the morphology fields and their possible values

commands.name: licenses
commands.summary: Data sources, licenses, and required attributions

commands.name: ref
commands.summary: Parse and normalize a reference.

commands.name: schema
commands.summary: Show CREATE TABLE statements for the scripture databases (core + attached study/lxx/user), plus notes on verse-id encoding and query conventions.

commands.name: sql
commands.summary: Run a read-only SQL query against the scripture databases (core, plus study/lxx/user when installed, attached under those schema names). Discover tables with 'bible schema'.

commands.name: db
commands.summary: Manage the local databases: status | download | path

commands.name: mcp
commands.summary: Run as an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server: stdio by default, or --http for remote connectors (Claude web/mobile, ChatGPT, ...)

options.description: serve MCP over Streamable HTTP instead of stdio

commands.name: agent-setup
commands.summary: Write the study-methodology guidance for an agent harness: claude | codex | opencode | generic

options.description: project directory to write into (default: cwd)
install for every session on this machine instead of one project (claude: ~/.claude/skills; codex: ~/.codex/AGENTS.md; opencode: ~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md)
print to stdout instead of writing files

commands.name: import
commands.summary: Import a translation you have licensed access to (USFM folder/zip/file, or TSV lines of '<ref><TAB><text>') into a local-only database for personal study.

options.description: short translation id to register (e.g. ESV, NIV84)
remove this translation id from the local database instead of importing

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: Diagnose the installation: platform, native SQLite driver, databases, integrity. Run this first when anything misbehaves.
